name: use-memoized-fn
title: useMemoizedFn
description: A hook that returns a memoized version of a function. Unlike `useCallback`, the function identity remains stable across re-renders, but it always has access to the latest props and state without needing a dependency array. This is particularly useful for passing callbacks to optimized child components to prevent unnecessary re-renders while avoiding closure staleness.

returnType.name: PickFunction<T>
returnType.description: A persistent function that internally calls the latest version of the passed function.
